about_the_game:
Join the adventure in our game Cosmic Cleaner! A casual cozy game experience where you wonder the galaxy while cleaning up humanity's leftovers!

Features

  • A cozy adventure through the stars: Explore tons of levels that bring unique challenges. Balance picking up normal space junk or toxic garbage and make it back to your HUB before the time runs out!

  • A serine soundtrack experience: Cosmic Cleaner has an atmospheric soundtrack that plays in the background of your space exploration. Enjoy cleaning up our solar system one piece of garbage at a time while enjoying the sights and sounds of deep space.

  • Endless space adventures: Once the story is completed, you will unlock an endless exploration mode! This is a limitless experience that allows you to upgrade your equipment over the regulation's max. Soar through the stars at insane speeds and collect tons of garbage!

What to expect in Cosmic Cleaner

  • Multiple story mode stages.

  • Endless exploration mode.

  • Upgradable equipment.

  • A beautiful soundtrack to enjoy the stars with.

  • Achievements for your deeds across the system.

  • A fun companion to accompany you on your journey!

name: Cosmic Cleaner

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: A dual-core processor (Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DirectX 11 (Integrated graphics like Intel UHD or AMD Vega)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or better, or AMD equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound

short_description: Soar among the stars in Cosmic Cleanup! You have been tasked with helping with a large-scale intergalactic cleanup! Joined by your friendly companion PIP you will work tirelessly to do your part in cleaning up our solar system! Join the effort today!
